oṃ swasti/'dir a tsa ra dmar chung gi lugs kyi thog ser srung thabs ni/rdo leb gtsang ma la 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi bskor ba'i lte bar chos 'byung bzhi

tei:div.tei:p: oṃ swasti/ 'dir a tsa ra dmar chung gi lugs kyi thog ser srung thabs ni/ rdo leb gtsang ma la 'khor lo mu khyud bzhi bskor ba'i lte bar chos 'byung bzhi brtsegs bsnol ma'i rtse mo bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar āḥyig dang rtse mo bcu gnyis la mgo nas brtsam ste yig mgo phyir bstan la/ dha dha swā rta ha tsa la rtsa pa hā gha ca/ zhes pa re re bzhin du bri/ de yi phyi rim mu khyud la/ e ka he dun ma ma snying khrag raṃ tsa yaṃ e myog yab hub mrug sha duṃ/ yul phyogs 'di rnams la ser ba ma gtang cig /ces dang*/ de'i phyi rim la/ e ka he dun ma ma rakṣa dza mun tri daṃ ma tring shu snying la sarba 'du ru raṃ thog ser ur nan/ sarba tsitta gzer thum trig nan/ rbad chod phyung bur yul phyogs lo tog la sde brgyad kyi gnod pa srungs shig /ser byed 'byung po thams cad mā ra ya zlog /ces dang*/ de'i phyi rim la ā li kā li dang ye dharma 'dod gsol dang bcas/ de'i phyi rim me ri g.yas skor du bris te/ la chas byug la mdun ser ba 'ong phyogs la bstan/ de'i g.yas su sātstsha'i nang du/ oṃ badzra dun dun rab ta mi li mi li phye shag phye shag phuḥphaṭa swā hā/ zhes bris la bcug /g.yon du skyer pa'i phur pa sor bzhi pa la sngags 'di bri/ na mo buddha ya ki li mi li tsan dha nā ga mi ri li ye swā hā/ zhes phur bu de nyid khro bor bsgom/ rdo 'khor de'i mdun du sātstsha che ba gcig gi nang du gzhung bsnyen 'di bris la mjug nas yar dril la bcug /oṃ e ka he dun ya rakṣa dzaḥ mun tri shu snying la sarba dhu ru raṃ thog ser ur nan sarba tsitta gzer thuṃ trig nan/ rbad chod gting phyung rbud nan sde brgyad kyi srog la myog rbad sarba nā ga tsitta thuṃ rbud nan/ rlung skyil snying gzer rbad nan/ zhal brlas shag tsi tra rbad/ khaṃ shag tsitta rbad/ sarba nā ga tsitta thuṃ tsitta nan/

trig nan rbad chod swā hā/ zhes bris la yungs dkar gyi thun dang bcas te nang du rdzongs la rab gnas bya/ ser ba 'ong lam brag gi dkyil du nam mkha' mthong bar bya'o// 'di la bsnyen pa bya mi dgos zab bo// 1$0000250༈ yang ser srung mu stegs sātstsha nag po yod/ 1$0000300bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon klu sgrub kyis mu stegs pa'i grong khyer du ser ba phabs pa'i tshe/ ji ltar mdzad kyang ser ba phab ma thub pas/ grogs po gandharna gsang bya ba la khyod rdzu 'phrul gyis songs la mu stegs pa rnams kyi ser ba gang gi srung 'dug ltos shog gsungs pa las/ de song tshe slob dpon gyis sprin gyi chu 'dril ba ltar byas nas ser ba shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam phab tshe/ mu stegs pa rnams kyis sātstsha nag po zhig gnam la bstan nas sngags bsgrangs te ral gri g.yug cing 'dug go /de nas gandharna gsang gis mu stegs pa la ngan sngags thams cad zhus pa las 'di ltar sātstsha zhig po dang*/ lha khang byin rlabs can gyi sa dang*/ yul gru stong pa'i sa dang*/ khang pa rnying pa'i sa/ lha'i bag rdul rtsam bsres pas sātstsha zhig byas pa'i khongs su sngags 'di bri la bcug /e gad ha bing*/ a khad pa hi thing tshe thing thing*/ a bhi gad/ a bhi sa/ rad mi bha ga da swā hā/ zhes bris la rang sngags khri phrag gcig btab la mjug nas yar dril te tsha tsha'i nang du bcug go /yul gru srung na tsha tsha dgu dang yungs thun rnams phyogs mtshams rnams dang*/ ser lam du bzhag nas ser ba ser bdag dang bcas pa stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'og tu mnan par bsam mo/ ༈ /rgyal mo khag chung gis rgya'i rgyal po de wa rā dza la gser srang gang phul nas zhus/ rgya'i chu gcod nag po zhes pa 'di lha sa 'phrul snang gi rdo ring la bris pas da lta yang ser ba 'ong mi srid do// de la a tsa ra rdo rje dpal rtse ngo mtshar skyes nas/ dpe bshus te bla ma gnyan chung ba la gnang ba'o// de yang shug pa'i byang bu la 'di bri/

oṃ a tri ni sa la sa shu /sa ru so ka shag /sra su kri rna nan bhyo/ bzlog khroṃ bhyo bhyo/ bzlog bzlog /shag su khraṃ bhyo bzlog /ra li hur thuṃ dzaḥbhyo bzlog /ra sha hur thuṃ bhyo bzlog /ya ra sha ra hur thuṃ bhyo bzlog /sa ma ya shi shi hur thuṃ bhyo bzlog /sarba shi hur thuṃ bhyo bzlog /sa ma ya bhyo bhyo/ sarba bzlog /ces nar mar bris te spra tshil gyis byugs/ yul khams srung na phyogs bzhi la btsugs/ shin tu zab bo// sa ma ya/ maṅga laṃ/// /
